because: Counterexample on 3c51594 (ROADMAP item 10): SIGNAL:trap|... on the IPC socket was counted in sokol_detections_total{source="trap"}, as a trap hit of this node; an_adapter_cannot_be_counted_under_a_source_of_this_node saw the trap row move by 1.
statement: An adapter on the IPC socket cannot be counted under this node's own sources: a decision whose adapter names itself trap or telemetry counts as other in sokol_detections_total. It is enforced and audited as before, under the name it gave.
